2608.02470.title: Grounding Agentic VLMs with Dedicated Segmentation for Fine-Grained Vehicle Damage Assessment
2608.02470.paper_summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as reasoning agents in real-world visual assessment pipelines, yet their spatial grounding remains unreliable for fine-grained, visually ambiguous targets. We study this gap in the context of automated vehicle damage assessment, where fine-grained defects such as scratches and hairline cracks occupy few pixels, produce weak gradient signal, and are easily confused with reflections and surface texture. We show that a state-of-the-art VLM (Qwen-VL) achieves strong semantic classification accuracy (87.3%) on this task but is systematically ungrounded at the spatial level: it hallucinates damage in reflective regions, misses elongated scratches entirely, and produces spatially inconsistent outputs when prompted for localization. We propose TinyDamage, a hybrid architecture that delegates spatial grounding to a dedicated multi-task segmentation model while reserving the VLM for semantic reasoning and report generation. On the segmentation side, we find that the choice of loss function has an outsized and underexplored effect on tiny-object grounding: focal loss, widely used for class imbalance, collapses tiny-damage detection to zero, while a supervised contrastive objective measurably improves damage/background separability. We integrate the segmentation model into a 7-node LangGraph agent pipeline that grounds every VLM generation step in the segmentation output, and show that this grounding reduces the report hallucination rate from 92% (text-only) and 78% (image-only) to 31% in a controlled evaluation on 100 human-verified reports. We introduce DET_l, a permissive per-category detection metric for evaluating tiny-object grounding under class imbalance, and report latency and reliability characteristics of the deployed pipeline.
2608.02470.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLMs）越來越多地被用作現實世界視覺評估流程中的推理代理，但它們在細粒度、視覺模糊目標上的空間基礎仍然不可靠。<lb/>我們在自動化車輛損傷評估的背景下研究這一差距，其中細粒度缺陷如刮痕和發絲裂縫佔據的像素很少，產生的梯度信號微弱，且容易與反射和表面紋理混淆。<lb/>我們顯示出一個最先進的VLM（Qwen-VL）在這項任務上達到了強大的語義分類準確率（87.3%），但在空間層面上系統性地缺乏基礎：它在反射區域中幻覺出損傷，完全漏掉了細長的刮痕，並在被要求進行定位時產生空間不一致的輸出。<lb/>我們提出了TinyDamage，一種混合架構，將空間基礎委派給專門的多任務分割模型，同時保留VLM用於語義推理和報告生成。<lb/>在分割方面，我們發現損失函數的選擇對細小物體的基礎有著過大且未被充分探索的影響：焦點損失，廣泛用於類別不平衡，將細小損傷檢測壓縮至零，而監督對比目標則可顯著改善損傷/背景的可分性。<lb/>我們將分割模型整合進一個7節點的LangGraph代理管道中，該管道在每個VLM生成步驟中都基於分割輸出進行基礎，並顯示這種基礎將報告幻覺率從92%（僅文本）和78%（僅圖像）降低至31%，在對100個人類驗證報告的控制評估中。<lb/>我們引入了DET_l，一種允許每類別檢測的指標，用於在類別不平衡下評估細小物體的基礎，並報告了部署管道的延遲和可靠性特徵。
